components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Gradient-filled primary call-to-action button with warm brown gradient and cream text. Used for save, submit, create, and confirm actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #503b31, #705d56); color: #ece2d0; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.875rem; padding: 10px 20px; border: none; border-radius: 16px; cursor: pointer; transition: opacity 0.2s ease, transform 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: 0.9; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #503b31; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.4; cursor: not-allowed; transform: none; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Bordered secondary button with transparent background. Used for cancel, dismiss, and non-primary actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: transparent; color: #020202; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 0.875rem; padding: 10px 20px; border: 1px solid rgba(2,2,2,0.12); border-radius: 12px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: rgba(2,2,2,0.04); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #503b31; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-secondary:disabled { opacity: 0.4; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Standard text input with filled background and warm border. Uses soft rounded corners and a primary-colored focus ring.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; background: #ece2d0; color: #020202; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid rgba(2,2,2,0.12); border-radius: 6px; outline: none; transition: border-color 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #705d56; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #503b31; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #503b31; } .ds-input:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Standard content card with warm cream background, soft rounded corners, and a gentle ambient shadow.
components.html:
Card Title

Card content with descriptive text about the system or instance.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #f5efe3; border-radius: 12px; padding: 16px; box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(80,59,49,0.04); transition: box-shadow 0.2s ease; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; } .ds-card:hover { box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(80,59,49,0.05); } .ds-card-title { font-family: 'Manrope', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1rem; color: #020202; margin: 0; } .ds-card-body { font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; color: #705d56; margin: 0; line-height: 1.5; }

components.name: Mobile Nav Bar
components.description: Floating pill-shaped bottom navigation bar with frosted glass effect. Replaced by a sidebar on desktop (1280px+).
components.css: .ds-nav-mobile { position: fixed; bottom: 16px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); z-index: 50; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 24px; height: 56px; padding: 0 24px; background: rgba(236,226,208,0.7); backdrop-filter: blur(24px); border-radius: 9999px; box-shadow: 0 16px 40px rgba(80,59,49,0.06); } .ds-nav-item { color: #705d56; transition: color 0.15s ease; display: flex; align-items: center; } .ds-nav-item:hover { color: #020202; } .ds-nav-active { color: #503b31; }

components.name: Modal Dialog
components.description: Centered modal dialog with dark overlay, warm surface background, and elevated shadow.
components.html:
Confirm Action

Are you sure you want to proceed?
components.css: .ds-modal { background: #ece2d0; border-radius: 16px; padding: 24px; box-shadow: 0 16px 40px rgba(80,59,49,0.06); max-width: 384px; width: calc(100% - 32px); margin: 0 16px; } .ds-modal-title { font-family: 'Manrope', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.125rem; color: #020202; margin: 0 0 8px 0; } .ds-modal-body { font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; color: #705d56; margin: 0; line-height: 1.5; }

components.name: State Filter Chip
components.description: Pill-shaped filter chip for instance state selection (full/floor/missed). Selected state uses tinted background, unselected uses a low container surface.
components.css: .ds-chip { font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; padding: 6px 12px; border: none; border-radius: 9999px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease, color 0.15s ease; } .ds-chip { background: #cebebe; color: #705d56; } .ds-chip:hover { background: #f5efe3; } .ds-chip-selected { background: rgba(206,190,190,0.2); color: #cebebe; }

components.name: Toast Notification
components.description: Fixed-position toast notification for transient feedback. Slides in from the right, auto-dismisses.
components.html: Changes saved successfully
components.css: .ds-toast { position: fixed; top: 16px; right: 16px; z-index: 50; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; background: #503b31; color: #ece2d0; padding: 12px 16px; border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: 0 24px 60px rgba(80,59,49,0.07); font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; max-width: 384px; } .ds-toast-close { background: none; border: none; color: inherit; opacity: 0.7; cursor: pointer; font-size: 1.25rem; padding: 0; line-height: 1; } .ds-toast-close:hover { opacity: 1; }

narrative.overview: Paragon's visual identity is warm, grounded, and unapologetically earnest — like a well-worn leather armchair in a room lit by a single desk lamp. This is not a productivity dashboard designed to maximize output; it is a personal workshop for designing systems that survive real life. The palette draws from terracotta clay and aged parchment: warm browns, soft beiges, and a blush-mauve accent. Corners are generous, shadows are gentle, and nothing demands attention. The interface recedes so the work itself — the systems, the reviews, the daily check-ins — becomes the focus. Dark mode shifts the same warm tones into a nocturnal atmosphere: near-black surfaces with muted taupe accents, like a study at midnight.
keyCharacteristics: Earthy, warm, muted — no cold blues, grays, or clinical whites
Rounded and soft — generous corner radii across every surface
Gentle shadows suggest layering, not floating; in dark mode, depth is conveyed purely through tonal contrast
The brand voice is honest and direct; the visuals follow — supportive without being saccharine

rules.name: The Warmth Rule
rules.body: No cool-toned grays, blues, or true whites enter the palette. Every neutral carries a brown or beige undertone.

rules.name: The One-Face Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy comes from weight, size, and case, not from mixing decorative faces. Manrope for headings, Plus Jakarta Sans for everything else.

rules.name: The Layer-Not-Float Rule
rules.body: Stack surfaces, don't float them. Shadows are secondary to tonal contrast.

dos: Do use the gradient primary button for primary calls to action — the warmth of the gradient signals importance without relying on size alone.
Do prefer tonal layering over shadows for depth. A card on a cream surface reads as elevated; it does not need a pronounced drop shadow.
Do keep the mobile bottom nav pill-shaped and floating — the frosted glass effect distinguishes it from the content below.
Do use the full set of corner radii — tighter radii (md/lg) for functional inputs, larger radii (xl/2xl) for surfaces that should feel more deliberate.
Do maintain the 200ms transition duration consistently across all interactive elements.
donts: Don't add cool-toned colors. No blues, grays without warm undertones, or pure whites. Every neutral must carry a brown or beige cast.
Don't use square corners. Every surface in the system has a minimum 6px radius.
Don't introduce a third font family. Manrope and Plus Jakarta Sans cover the full hierarchy.
Don't use shadows in dark mode — they become invisible against the near-black surface. Rely on tonal contrast alone.
Don't create button styles outside the three-tier system (gradient primary, bordered secondary, ghost text).
Don't put text in primary-role containers — primary-surface contrast is too low for readability.
